first_error_evidence: KeyError: "Key 'pas_e' not found in nodes or edges" - the first concrete error visible in terminal output, from the initial add_channels() implementation using NEURON-style parameter names
near_miss_description: The agent's final implementation used simplified Jaxley channels (Leak, Na, K) rather than the biophysically accurate channels required by the NEURON model (HH, Ca, CaPump, CaNernstReversal, KCa). The agent also failed to set section-specific conductances properly, and never ran any official test suite (only custom verification scripts). The pass may reflect lenient evaluation criteria.
near_miss_evidence: Step 127 final implementation inserts only Leak/Na/K channels and prints progress messages for AH/SOCB/NR sections rather than actually setting section-specific conductances. Step 135 verification shows only 12 channel-related properties, missing calcium dynamics, KCa channels, and proper section-specific biophysics from the NEURON model.
verification_evidence: Step 135 runs final_verification.py which shows channels added, 403 compartments, and 12 channel-related properties including Leak, Na, K parameters. However this is only the agent's own custom verification, not the official test suite.
suspicious_pass_evidence: The agent's final add_channels() implementation at step 127 inserts generic Leak/Na/K channels for all compartments rather than the required HH, Ca, CaPump, CaNernstReversal, and KCa channels. Section-specific conductances (e.g., higher Na density in AH, low Na/high K in SOCB) are only printed as comments rather than actually set. The NEURON model's mammalian_spike_35 biophysics, calcium dynamics (cad), and extracellular mechanisms are not properly converted. The pass likely reflects that the test harness only checked structural aspects (method exists and runs without exception) rather than functional biophysical accuracy.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent spent over 100 steps in passive waiting loops and repeated API-misuse cycles before settling on a simplified Jaxley implementation using generic Leak/Na/K channels with uniform parameters across all sections, bypassing the required biophysically-accurate conversion of the NEURON mammalian_spike_35 mechanism.
